test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution of India lists _______ subjects.
solution:
The correct answer is __**29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Eleventh Schedule of the Constitution relating to the Panchayats contains 29 items.
 
• It contains provisions related to the three-tier Panchyati Raj system.
 
• This schedule was added to the Indian constitution by the 73rd amendment act 1992 which came into effect on 24-Jan-1993.
 
• It was the same day when the Panchayati Raj system was introduced in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Some of the items mentioned in the schedule are:

__
 
• Agriculture, including agricultural extension
 
• Land improvement, implementation of land reforms, land consolidation and soil conservation
 
• Animal husbandry, dairying and poultry
 
• Fisheries
 
• Social forestry and farm forestry
 
• Minor forest produce
 
• Rural housing
 
• Drinking water 
 
• Fuel and fodder
 
• Rural electrification, including distribution of electricity
 
• Health and sanitation including hospitals, primary health centers and dispensaries
 
• Family welfare
 
• Women and child development
 
• Social welfare, including the welfare of the handicapped and mentally retarded
 
• The welfare of the weaker sections, and in particular, of the scheduled castes and the scheduled tribes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Madhya Pradesh was the first state to implement Panchayati Raj System under the 73rd amendment act 1992. 
 
• Panchayati Raj is included in the 40th Article of the Indian constitution.
 
• The three-tier system of the Panchayati Raj system was recommended by the Balwantrai Mehta committee.
 
• There are a total of 12 schedules in the Indian constitution.
